tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything (`.omer-root`). Ground for `ink`, `muted`, `gold-strong`, `warn` and `ok` text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels: DayHero, tab panel, dialogs, dedication card, floating bars. Text on it: `ink`, `muted`, `gold-strong`, `warn`, `ok`.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells and inset fills: tab bar track, ask-item rows, form controls, activity strip, inactive menorah channels. Text on it: `ink`, `muted`, `warn`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2` and `gold-wash` (8.5:1 or more in both themes). Also the Toast fill, which carries `bg` text (13:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, hints, status line, section headings, legend. On `bg` 5.3:1 light / 7.5:1 dark; on `surface` 6.0 / 6.6; on `surface-2` 4.9 / 5.6.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand accent: primary button fill, today's day number, counted cells, flames, highlight rule, and the focus ring (3px outline, 3.6:1 or more on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-2` in both themes). Used as text on `surface`: 4.47:1 in light, just under 4.5 (the day number is 3.4rem display type), and 3.9:1 on `bg`; 8.2:1 and 9.3:1 in dark. Source value kept.

tokens.name: gold-strong
tokens.usage: Gold text that has to read: kavanot values, count line, hesed points, today's word. On `gold-wash` 5.6:1 light / 7.1:1 dark; on `surface` 6.9 / 10.1; on `bg` 6.0 / 11.5.

tokens.name: gold-wash
tokens.usage: Highlight fill behind `gold-strong` or `ink` text: kavanot tiles, today's line and word, count line, earned badge, locked button. In dark it is `gold` at 17% over `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and outlines: card borders, dividers, outline buttons, switch track, unfilled cells, inactive channels. At 1.3:1 to 1.7:1 on `bg` and `surface` it is a decorative separator, not a 3:1 control boundary; source value kept.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Halachic warnings and missed days: banner border and title, dashed missed cells, danger-button fill. As text on `surface`, `bg` and `surface-2` 4.9:1 or more in both themes. The danger button's white label is 6.1:1 on light `warn` and 2.5:1 on dark `warn`; source value kept.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Completed state: done-button outline and label. On `surface` 6.3:1 light / 8.3:1 dark; on `bg` 5.5 / 9.5.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `gold` fills: primary button, play button, today's cell, today's menorah word. 4.0:1 on light `gold` (under 4.5 for the 700-weight button label; source value kept), 10:1 on dark `gold`. Same value in both themes.

styles.name: day-number
styles.usage: Gematria day number in DayHero (`.daynum .n`), set in `gold`.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Full count text in DayHero (`.count`). Size scales with `--fs`.

styles.name: count-line
styles.usage: Count line inside the siddur (`.sid .countline`), `gold-strong` on `gold-wash`. Size scales with `--fs`.

styles.name: prayer
styles.usage: Prayer text in PrayerSection and AnaBekoach (`.sid p`). Scales fully with `--fs`.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Quote of the day (`.quote`). Size scales with `--fs`.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base UI text on `.omer-root`. The root font size is 17px times `--ui`.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Status line, notes, hints, legend (`.status`, `.note`, `.legend`), usually in `muted`.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels (`.btn`); the small size uses 0.9rem.

tokens.name: radius-box
tokens.usage: Tiles and notices: kavanot tiles, banners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tabs, badges and the floating bars (fully rounded).

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: AutoScrollBar, the floating pill. A literal in the stylesheet, not a custom property.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: MiniBar, the sticky top bar. A literal in the stylesheet, not a custom property.
